profile.headline: Engineering solutions to fix tomorrow's problems today
profile.geoLocationName: San Diego County, California, United States
profile.summary:
Professional Experience
==========================
* Software Engineer @ Google - Android Treble - July 2022 - Present
Making Android integration smoother and faster for SoCs and OEMs by:
- Developing tooling to automate costly operations, mostly in Golang
- Creating self-updating dashboards to track KPIs
- Implementing agentic solutions for all the above so I can build out even more things

*Engineering Manager @ Abalta Technologies - March 2022 - June 2022
Guide career progression of developers
Improve engineer engagement and alignment with company goals
Recruitment, retention, and recognition!!

* Senior Software Engineer @ Abalta Technologies - June 2017 -March 2022
Development, testing, and triaging of In-Vehicle software applications. Strong experience with Qt stack and C++ running on the QNX platform as well as Android-based applications written in Java. Contributed to test automation efforts using Cucumber, GoogleTest, C++, Ruby.

*Software Development Engineer @ Qualcomm - June 2015 - December 2017
Designing, implementing, testing, debugging, integrating, and triage of bootloader. Experience with owning and delivering software images and coordinating with numerous teams.
Technologies used: C, Assembly, Python, T32/Practice, Scons, Perforce.

*Engineering Intern @ Qualcomm June 2015 - July 2015
Developed and tested an alternate flow for touch processing solution leverage Trustzone ARM technology. Gained experience with benchmarking and profiling code performance.
Technologies used:   ADB, Android Fastboot, Android SDK, Android NDK, C, C++, Linux.

Side Projects
==========================
*Order Readiness Notification System - Designed and implemented a solution to send a SMS message to customers when their order(s) are ready. Using the Twilio API, I was able to write a python script to add this feature instead of having to pay to upgrade to a new P.O.S. system that supports this.

*3D Printing - I've been printing since December 2016 and haven't stopped. I began designing 3D models as well. I typically model parts in a traditional CAD program and model organic things using Blender.

*CNC milling machine - Designed and built the machine using an Arduino Uno for the controls and 3D printed parts (see 3D Printing below)

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Automation Test Framework for SDK Validation
Role: Tech Lead and Developer
* Saved ~150 hours per regression cycle by replacing manual testing with automated tests
* Converted SDK requirements into Gherkin/BDD style syntax
* Developed step functions to convert from BDD steps to C++ code to exercise SDK APIs
* Used Cucumber (Ruby) to generate integration tests
* Leveraged Jenkins to provide a unified platform/setup for validating test execution
* Technologies used: RubyMine IDE, Ruby, Visual Studio, C++, Jenkins, Charles Web Proxy, JSON, GitHub, Git

FCA/Stellantis In-Vehicle Messaging and Wifi Management Applications
Role: Developer
* Developed Android applications using Android Studio for multiple screen formats
* Overhauled the UI for both applications
* Worked with stakeholders to redefine outdated product requirements documentation
* Technologies used: Java, XML, Android Studio, ADB, 

SiriusXM 360L In-Vehicle Music Streaming Applications
Role: Developer
* Development and triage of applications in C++ with Qt Framework running on the QNX platform.
* Also worked on an Android client, written in Java
* Validated application using hardware benches (via CAN simulator) and inside test vehicles
* Utilized C++11 features and optimizations daily in development of new application features.
* Technologies used: C++11, OOP,  multi-threaded, concurrency, QNX, VMWare, UI, Git, Agile, Qt, Qml, json

Recruitment
Role: Campus Recruitment and Interviewer
* Attended a career fair at UCSD to bring attention to the company and attract top talent
* Conducted interviews for prospective interns, junior/senior developers, and management roles

- Experience with bringing up new targets in SCons and EDK2 build environments
- Participated in routine code reviews

Software Integration

- Development, deployment, and maintenance of python based build scripts
- Ensured software quality/stability via test frameworks
- Managed software dependencies across teams to provide smooth software releases

projects.title: Bootloader development for first 5G modem
projects.description: Developed and delivered the secondary bootloader for the first 5G modem for wireless devices. This includes pre-silicon development in emulation environments, post-silicon bringup, and ongoing support. Development efforts required communicating inter-team dependencies, verifying legacy  features and implementing new features, integrating bootloader drivers, and debugging issues.

patents.title: Boot time determination of calibration for a component
patents.description: LPDDR4 RAM modules require calibration to perform at maximum efficiency. The training takes about a minute to perform. This patent covers the method of storing this calibration data and loading it up at boot time so that the calibration does not need to be performed again. Calibration data can be stored in on-chip flash memory or supplied over pcie/USB busses.
